oa-deloitte-2.title: Count Balanced Nodes in a Tree
oa-deloitte-2.sourceFacts: The immutable page states the rooted-tree definition, compares subtree sizes one per direct child, and explicitly says a leaf with no children is trivially balanced.
oa-deloitte-2.siteAdditions: The upstream has no serialization format, root/node-label convention, or size bound. This candidate uses root node 1 with a parent list for nodes 2..n and site cap n<=200000; these are site I/O/resource additions, not upstream rules.
